method: Repository ArcGIS adapter; 3x3 grid of 0.0025-degree cells at WUP Recife center and same grid shifted +0.004 degrees lon/lat. Feature geometries were transient validation inputs only; this record contains no parcel IDs or geometries.

source.publisher: Prefeitura do Recife, ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 3

technicalBlockers: 12 cells failed because SEQIMOVEL was missing or invalid on returned rows.
One cell failed because the same SEQIMOVEL had conflicting polygons; this was an adapter integrity rejection after successful HTTP responses, not an upstream HTTP error.
The 226 retained IDs exact-read successfully in batches of 80, 80, and 66 with no absent IDs, but exact reads do not repair incomplete spatial coverage.
decision: Hold this ArcGIS layer as an alternative; do not substitute SEQIMOVEL for a durable parcel key without a published, stable identity contract. The existing static GeoJSON source and DSQFL assessment remain separately recorded.
